title: AmEx Qantas Spend $500 Get $75 Back Offer
body:
Hi everyone, just wondering if anyone has experience with this Amex offer.
I have an offer on my Amex card to spend $500 at Qantas and receive $75 cashback. I'm wondering whether purchases made through the Qantas Marketplace Store would also qualify, or whether the offer is strictly limited to flight bookings.
I've read the terms and conditions, which mention that the offer is only valid for flights booked directly through the Qantas Australian website.
Has anyone tried purchasing something from Qantas Marketplace under a similar offer and successfully received the Amex cashback?
Would appreciate hearing about your experience. Thanks!
